title: Independent machine network: custody-separated mission with subcontract, shared pool, relay and blackout

steps.step: funding: zero-value development asset credited to the requester only (fixture); service holds no actor key

competition for the shared antenna pool (one channel): two signed reservations raced for the same half hour across two overlapping offers; exactly one admitted, the other refused without reserving funds
acquisition milestone settled (signed by the requester); the compute milestone awarded to the primary machine under frozen terms

subcontract: requester prefunded 12 (signed at sig-requester), subcontractor delivered and was paid 10 by the primary (signed at sig-machine), 2 unused returned to the requester (signed at sig-machine)

failed delivery branch: the second subcontract (funded 4 from the machine's own settled earnings) was rejected by verification; nothing paid for it; the child award closed and the machine's reservation was released; the primary remains responsible for the parent milestone
steps.note: the primary remains responsible for its own parent obligation; a supplier failure does not erase it

steps.step: terrain analysis computed from the pinned public tile and accepted by the verifier (not yet settled)

product.scope: exact bounded search on the declared tile and rover model

provenance.label: NASA PDS LOLA GDR LDEM_4 extract (public archive data; real measurements, resampled grid)
provenance.datum: sphere radius 1737.4 km; MEAN EARTH/POLAR AXIS OF DE421 body-fixed
provenance.orientation: line 1 = +90 deg latitude (north up); sample 1 = 0 deg east longitude; east to the right
provenance.redistribution: NASA PDS archive data; publicly released without restriction stated in the label; cite LRO LOLA team (D. E. Smith, GSFC), data set LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
provenance.what_this_is_not: a 7.58 km/pixel shape grid: no rock, crater (<7.6 km), traction or illumination information; slopes are grid-scale proxies, not traversability truth

assumptions: slope is the grid-scale gradient of a resampled DEM (pixel spacing as declared); features smaller than one pixel (rocks, small craters, scarps) are invisible
simple cylindrical grid: north-south spacing is constant, east-west spacing is pixel_spacing * cos(latitude) per row (computed per row; polar rows are refused)
heights are DN * scaling relative to the reference sphere; no geoid correction (slopes are unaffected by a constant offset)
vertical error is a declared parameter applied as an independent bound on every neighbour (not a measured error model)
edge cells use one-sided differences and are flagged; cells touching nodata have no slope (flagged nodata)
this is not a traversability, traction, illumination or communication product
energy per step = length * (flat cost + slope cost * slope of the entered cell); no slope sign (uphill and downhill cost alike), no battery dynamics, no thermal or illumination terms
passability is the slope of the entered cell against the rover limit; the grid-scale slope is a proxy (sub-pixel hazards are not modelled)

eight-neighbour moves; diagonal length = sqrt(ns^2 + ew^2) per row; the search minimizes energy, then checks length (a shorter-but-costlier route is not explored: a length violation is INDETERMINATE, not INFEASIBLE)
INFEASIBLE is exact for the declared model and tile only (nothing outside the tile is considered)
safety-critical control must not depend on this product or on any payment response

steps.step: blackout: link cut; mission settled locally from reserved funds (provider 40 + fee 2 + verifier 3, each signed by the requester); a 10-unit claim exported to the machine from dom-a is certified but undeliverable; the machine cannot spend it
machine purchased compute from its settled earnings on the shared pool (signed at sig-machine, still in blackout); measured delivery settled to the supplier

relay with safe replanning: the first route missed its early contact window and was released in full (never charged); the replanned two-hop route carried the product (hop fees signed at sig-machine), the requester acknowledged the content hash, both hops settled once
reconnection: the certificate was delivered, the 10-unit claim credited to the machine at dom-c and acknowledged at dom-a; witness checkpoint recorded
fee-funded contribution: the treasury paid a distinct recipient 2 from collected fees only (never more than confirmed fee revenue)

blackout.rule: during a cut link only local actions within already funded reservations and preallocated authority proceed; relay, cross-domain and witness-dependent actions are refused with link_cut

recovery.rollback_detection: UNAVAILABLE: no witness reachable and no watermark file; a restored database cannot be told from the newest one

operator_screen_during_blackout.source: projection of journal, obligations, reservations, allocations, missions and controller validation; no second balance

custody_note: every spend by the requester, the primary machine and the supplier was signed at that party's own signer process (sig-requester, sig-machine, sig-supplier); the subcontractor, verifier, relay and contribution recipient share sig-others; the API and worker processes hold no actor key; cross-domain exports remain a development-custody action at dom-a in this order
